newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico two-year Bondes up slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico two-year Bondes up slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.35 percentage points to 1.49 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.35173 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 2.369 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on 364-day Bondes rose 0.04 percentage points to 1.75 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The one-year Bondes were assigned at 98.70490 pesos.
The demand for the 500 million pesos worth on offer was 1.365 billion pesos.
